displayIdentity.body: Paul is hailed, stoned, and rises in Lystra. At Lystra a certain man sat, impotent in his feet, a cripple from his mother’s womb, who never had walked. But as the disciples stood around him, he rose up, and entered into the city. On the next day he went out with Barnabas to Derbe.
